-- Let me try a comprehensive Health Resilience Score calculation
-- Using numeric columns and converting enums to scores
WITH health_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.beneregistry as registry_id,
        eh.envdistref,
        -- Numeric health indicators (all on similar scale 0-100)
        eh.waterqualityindex,
        eh.sanitationcoverage,
        eh.vaccinationcoverage,
        eh.recyclepct,
        eh.renewenergypct,
        -- Convert enums to numeric scores
        CASE eh.diseaserisk WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 1 END as disease_score,
        CASE eh.medicalemergencycapacity WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 3 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 END as medical_score,
        CASE eh.mentalhealthaid WHEN 'Available' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END as mental_score,
        CASE eh.wastemanagementstate WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 3 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 END as waste_score,
        CASE eh.envimpactrate WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 1 END as impact_score
    FROM beneficiariesandassessments ba
    JOIN environmentandhealth eh ON ba.benedistref = eh.envdistref
)
SELECT

    ROUND((waterqualityindex + sanitationcoverage + vaccinationcoverage + recyclepct + renewenergypct + disease_score*10 + medical_score*10 + mental_score*10 + waste_score*10 + impact_score*10) / 10.0, 2) as health_resilience_score
FROM health_scores
LIMIT 10;
